newsitem.title: ITALY: Bell Atlantic mulls European strategy.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic mulls European strategy.

text.p: U.S. telecom giant Bell Atlantic Corp will resume a push to increase its presence in Europe once it has settled into its merger with NYNEX, Bell's head of European operations told a newspaper on Sunday.
Bell's European head Giancarlo Ferrero told Italy's Il Sole 24 Ore newspaper in an interview it was however too early to say whether the group was seek any alliances.
"I expect a strong resumption of our push in Europe, maybe not straight away because we have to digest the merger," Ferrero said.

He said Bell's 17.4 percent shareholding in Italy's second mobile phone operator Omnitel was a very satisfying investment and while he didn't know whether Bell would increase its stake in the company, it was very interested in the future of Omnitel.
Bell is also partner with Omnitel's main shareholder Olivetti in another venture, Infostrada, in which it holds 33 percent.
Asked whether Bell was considering selling its stake, Ferrero said he preferred not to comment.
Bell's $25.6 billion merger with NYNEX, the biggest in U.S. history, was approved on Thursday.
